meta.name: formax-test-stability-workflow
meta.description: Use when adding or fixing Formax tests (especially Ink UI tests) and you need deterministic synchronization in test interactions.

copy.tagline: 为 Formax 测试添加确定性同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在编写或修复 Formax 的 Ink UI 测试，需要避免竞态条件。
copy.tagline_en: Add deterministic synchronization to Formax tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write or fix Formax Ink UI tests and need to avoid race conditions.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写稳定的 UI 测试，在测试中主动等待目标状态出现后再执行下一步，并提取重复的同步步骤为辅助函数。
howto.when: 当你需要添加或修复 Formax 测试（尤其是 Ink UI 测试），并且需要在测试交互中保持确定性同步时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个稳定的 Formax 测试，等待目标状态出现后再操作。
say.note: Claude 会生成带显式状态同步的测试代码。

say.text: 等待 ❯ 3. 出现后再输入反馈内容。
say.note: Claude 会在测试中插入等待条件。

say.text: 把重复的同步步骤提取成一个辅助函数。
say.note: Claude 会重构测试代码，封装同步逻辑。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write stable UI tests that wait for target state before proceeding and extract repeated sync steps into helper functions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when adding or fixing Formax tests (especially Ink UI tests) where deterministic synchronization in interactions is needed.

say_en.text: Write a stable Formax test that waits for target state before acting.
say_en.note: Claude generates test code with explicit state sync.

say_en.text: Wait for ❯ 3. to appear before typing feedback.
say_en.note: Claude inserts a wait condition in the test.

say_en.text: Extract repeated sync steps into a helper function.
say_en.note: Claude refactors test code to encapsulate sync logic.
